approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content, with file-grounded project questions modeled on Trunk Tools.
notes: Reproduce a correct RFI form Subject answer rejected by the former Email-only Subject guard.
Keep each explicit RFI/Submittal Subject equal to one complete cited value paired with the same exact workflow identifier.
Reject cross-item swaps, recombination and cross-source-finding borrowing.
Do not treat an Email Subject header as an RFI or Submittal form Subject.
Allow one exact evidence-locator identity to scope a Subject-only quotation and reject a multi-identity locator.
Require every answered RFI/Submittal Subject question to state the exact identifier and complete Subject.
Use synthetic evidence and make no provider request.
title: Ground RFI and Submittal Subject claims
objective: Allow exact RFI/Submittal Subject questions while preventing Subject values from being omitted, recombined, identity-swapped or borrowed from Email or another source finding.
